scope: Assistant-development analysis addendum recorded before any neural/certificate external-stress outcomes; not student preregistration
change: Add explicitly limited fixed-batch uncertainty alongside the already frozen conditional generated-draw summaries. Preserve all selected models, checkpoints, preprocessing, acquisition, and source-domain scales.
unit: One original generated velocity model, retaining all four source/frequency blocks; each family/checkpoint reported separately
finite_batch_method: Conservative exact hypergeometric CDF inversion: largest feasible K with Pr(X <= observed_failures | N=500, K, n=100) >= 0.05
finite_batch_assumptions: Uniform sampling of 100 original indices without replacement from the named fixed 500-model batch; evaluation choices and every model outcome fixed. No IID geological or real-site assumption is used for this fixed-batch result.
finite_batch_scope: Only the named batch's failure fraction. No generalization to another batch, family, environment, real site, field data, or the official OpenFWI seismic benchmark.
duplicate_handling: Conservatively withhold all intervals if within-batch or cross-family raw duplicate clusters are found; keep every selected model and block without resampling/discarding. Do not collapse duplicates and then claim a simple uniform 100-of-500 cluster sample.
conditional_generated_draw_summaries: Existing binomial and whole-model bootstrap summaries additionally assume independent generated-model draws. This is not verified real-site independence and is not a conformal OOD coverage guarantee.
multiplicity: Individual one-sided bounds and descriptive bootstrap intervals; no simultaneous guarantee across groups or outcomes
calibration: No fitting or recalibration. Existing source-domain calibrated gate outcomes remain descriptive OOD stress results with no nominal conformal coverage claim.
